paper_title: MBDRes-U-Net: Multi-Scale Lightweight Bra Tumor Segmentation
core_problem: The increasing computational burden of deep learning methods in medical imaging, specifically achieving good brain tumor segmentation performance with a lightweight model.
methodology_summary: Proposes the MBDRes-U-Net model using a three-dimensional (3D) U-Net codec framework, integrating multibranch residual blocks and fused attention to enrich feature expression and improve segmentation accuracy while maintaining a lightweight architecture.
datasets_eval: Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) Challenge 2018 and 2019 datasets
empirical_results: The architecture maintains high precision in brain tumor segmentation while considerably reducing calculation overhead.
explicit_limitations: Compared to attention mechanisms that focus on important channel-feature information, the initial grouping operation was discarded and 3D SE was used, and the multiple branches generated by channel grouping work independently.
